name: axioma-skills
description: Self-developed agentic coding skills. One plugin per directory under plugins/.

plugins.name: agentic-workflow
plugins.description: Per-feature, trunk-based agentic build workflow: roadmap and chunk planning, unattended build, fresh diff-only PR review (quality + security), and a retro that defaults to no change.

plugins.name: writer
plugins.description: A single portable agent that writes, rewrites or summarises prose in a plain, honest, peer-to-peer voice - for evidence records, analysis notes, CV and cover-letter paragraphs, orientation summaries, and correspondence. Reads a project's writing-style.md as an authoritative overlay on its built-in method.
